definition: Rerun of the pre-registered G0/G1/G2 fused system on 2026-10-28 with llama-server online, to test reproducibility of the agent-level numbers after the 2026-10-27 run produced an invalid NHANES arm (arbiter service down).
arbiter: local qwen3.8-27b, thinking disabled, temp=0.0, seed=20261015

naive_rag.note: significant at four of five seeds

invalidates.reason: its NHANES arms report TP=0 (all-negative), produced while llama-server was down: every arbiter-dependent gate fell through to arbiter_error and defaulted to negative. superseded by the 2026-10-28 rerun and by fused_system_R5.jsonl.

reading: The agent is reproducible but not transportable: on independent KNHANES data G2 is below its own deterministic rule layer (0.312 vs 0.360) because the evidence gates trade recall for precision. The NHANES matrix is in-sample and its recall of 1.000 is constructed by the post-confirmatory rule revision.
